description_expanded: ABOUT SEA-RENITY: Located in the quiet, beautiful neighborhood of Sunnyside Beach on the Westside of Panama City Beach, sits a tranquil beach house called "SEA-RENITY." Upon entering this open concept home, you will be drawn to the large sliding glass doors that open up to the private lagoon style pool with a waterfall and enormous screened in patio and fenced in backyard. "SEA-RENITY" is just a short bicycle ride or a less than 10 minute stroll through the very peaceful neighborhood to one of the most wonderful beaches in the world! The sugar white sand on your private beach area and emerald green water truly make you feel like you are in PARADISE. Recently updated, this 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home includes a large kitchen with new stainless steel appliances. The open living area features a large Smart TV with an updated surround sound system. This home sleeps 11 people, so be sure to bring the whole family and enjoy your own slice of paradise! This property is ideal for two families as well. In the evening, after relaxing at the beach all day, you can come home and shower off outside and take a quick dip in the pool. As you walk into the huge screened in patio you can hear the music of the ocean and the sound of the seagulls. Take advantage of the large, fenced in yard by playing ball with the kids or letting the dogs run. The pool has a safety fence and the yard is completely enclosed so perfect for letting the kiddos and the fur babies out to play. ABOUT THE AREA: The West End of Panama City Beach, Florida, is known for its serene and laid-back atmosphere, offering a more secluded and tranquil experience compared to the bustling areas in the heart of Panama City Beach. This area is characterized by its pristine white sandy beaches, crystal-clear emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico, and picturesque natural beauty. Visitors to the West End can enjoy a more peaceful beach experience with fewer crowds, perfect for relaxation and unwinding. The West End of Panama City Beach is home to a variety of charming beachfront communities, upscale resorts, and vacation rental properties, offering visitors a range of accommodation options to suit their preferences. From luxury beachfront condos to cozy beach cottages, there are plenty of choices for accommodations in this area. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the West End's proximity to natural attractions such as Camp Helen State Park and Conservation Park, where they can explore hiking and biking trails, spot local wildlife, and enjoy the beauty of the unique coastal landscape. Water sports enthusiasts can partake in activities such as paddleboarding, kayaking, and snorkeling in the calm waters of the Gulf. For those seeking dining and entertainment options, the West End of Panama City Beach offers a selection of waterfront restaurants, beach bars, and cafes serving up fresh seafood and local cuisine. Visitors can also explore nearby shopping areas, art galleries, and cultural attractions in the surrounding area. Overall, the West End of Panama City Beach is a hidden gem for those looking for a more peaceful and scenic beach experience, away from the hustle and bustle of the busier tourist areas, while still providing easy access to all the amenities and attractions that make Panama City Beach a sought-after destination on Florida's Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Public Beach Access PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Private Pool PARKING: * Free Parking for up to 4 Vehicles PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must Be 25 years or older * If you choose to bring your dog(s), there is an additional, non-refundable pet fee of $250 per dog. The fee is to be charged after reservation confirmation. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests. *Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to the properties we manage may go under construction without being notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage.
